details: SELENE OUTPOST – Moon Base: Survival 30 is a 2D lunar base survival game built with HTML5, JavaScript, Canvas 2D, SVG and Web Audio. The player commands four astronauts and keeps oxygen, water, food and power in balance. A shortage in one system affects the others, showing how interdependent a closed habitat is. Players explore with a rover, mine resources, build and repair structures, research technology inspired by real NASA work, and handle random events such as solar particle events and meteoroid impacts. The game has 5 levels, an AI advisor named ARIA, and several endings, including a secret ending after 6 years. Our goal is to make the challenges of living beyond Earth easy to understand and to show why humans must keep oversight of AI. Day and night length, dust, radiation and water ice are based on NASA sources; costs, yields and event timing are game-design values, not NASA data. Super Intelligence use: Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI) helped write code and draft content. The in-game assistant ARIA is rule-based and uses no language model at runtime. Graphics and sound are generated in code; no third-party images, music or fonts are used.
